mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS user_id, video_id AS video_id, SUM(weight) AS score FROM ( SELECT user_id, video_id, 1.0 AS weight FROM watch_history WHERE enable = 1 UNION ALL SELECT user_id, video_id, CASE WHEN type_enable = 1 THEN 3.0 ELSE -3.0 END AS weight FROM video_likes WHERE enable = 1 UNION ALL SELECT user_id, video_id, 5.0 AS weight FROM favorites WHERE enable = 1 ) AS combined GROUP BY user_id, video_id LIMIT #{limit}
